items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: He was with Sam Morgan one time ago, he sent me with Sam Morgan and Kid Ora was on trombone.

ctx.x: and I'll just go by that way. I just wonder if it's from the family way back in the colonial times probably. To get on with your musical education, we'll say, when you started on banjo, your brother used to help you. Oh yes. Did you play in a band pretty quick then?

Yeah, yes indeed. I played a band pretty quick. I remember my brother John sent me in his place. He was with Sam Morgan one time ago, he sent me with Sam Morgan and Kid Ora was on trombone. We was advertised in the street then, in trucks. I remember that this guy played in his place and many jobs I played in the Papa Salastain Band in my brother John's place.
Do you remember your very first job? Was that the one you substituted in Morgan's band?
